# tf::Executor

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/view/`](../folders/src-view.md)
> **Source:** [`src/view/game.cpp`](../../../src/view/game.cpp)

## Summary

The host's Taskflow thread pool.

## Description

Emplaced default-constructed (one worker per hardware thread) by Game's constructor. Used by ChunkGeneratorSys, TerrainColliders and the Renderer's parallel command recording. WorldStepperSys does not pass it to Worlds::step, so worlds step sequentially in dynamical. Defined by Taskflow, not by the engine.

## Fields

None (tag, opaque type or no data members).

## Side effects per system

- **[ChunkGeneratorSys](../systems/ChunkGeneratorSys.md)**
  - spawns TerrainGenerator::generate tasks on taskflow; in deterministic runs and in finish, busy-waits (yield) for them
- **[Renderer](../systems/Renderer.md)**
  - spawns up to 2 taskflow tasks
  - submits transfer, compute and graphics queues
- **[TerrainCollidersSys](../systems/TerrainCollidersSys.md)**
  - taskflow tasks (blocking for required cells, background for prefetch)
